method: the blend must build: one closed solid whose face count is the loft's 3 plus the blend's 1. A round or chamfer of a ruled spline wall has no closed-form volume, so the volume is not graded
what: a loft (ruled, degree 1) between two closed fit-point splines through 12 points of a circle, radius 15 at x = -30 and radius 20 at x = 30, each spline given as 12 cubic Bezier pieces that join with one tangent direction and unequal speeds; the two sections' speed ratios at a joint differ, so the loft face's normal turns by 4.1e-10 rad across 8 of its 12 knot lines (worked out from the control points: (1-u) a0 T0 + u a1 T1 against (1-u) b0 T0 + u b1 T1). The rim of the larger end, one closed edge, rounded R2 must give one closed solid of 4 faces
